scenicChapters.title: Garden Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 307 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Garden Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 65 km this is Garden Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

south-africa-garden-route-high-and-coast.story: It goes by way of back through Knysna lagoon and back through Wilderness beach. It is a high-mountain day.
